description.content:
A deal represents a promotional offer created by a brand for their program. Each deal has a type (such as a general sale, BOGO, free shipping, rebate, or gift with purchase) and contains detailed discount rules, scope, and optional product or category associations. Deals are accessed as a sub-resource of a campaign.
